summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are filming a movie in which Ayumi will write its process into her illustrated diary with the help of Kogoro, the topic of the movie is the case in which Kogoro had captured the graffiti vandaliser. It’s kinda hard to believe that a group of 7-year-old kids can actually make use of editing tools and CG-tech to make the product more convincing, to the point in which it can help win a prize for them and give ideas for Ayumi besides being just a class report. Location: Sakuma Liquor Store and Imakiya Japanese Candy Shop (in Beika Town) Weapons: Spray paint, metal bat Suspects: Kohei Miki The next day, the boys go out to ask some people about the said vandalism: The first one is Takagi, who actually received the information of the case from Kogoro as the vandalism is not assigned for Division 1, he recalls that the items left at the scene were two used paint sprayers while the vending machine and many plant pots were smashed with a baseball bat. He also notes that the camera footage were not available due to the paint, the surrounding neighbors couldn’t give effective clues, and the owner of the sabotaged store didn’t know who could’ve done that as well. The second one is Chiba, he recalls that the second vandalism is almost identical to the first one as the wall is painted with graffiti while the surroundings were damaged by a baseball bat, and there was no effective clue to help them, even the bicycle tire tracks wouldn't help, as well. Location: Sakata Residence and Restaurant Gulf Stream (in Beika Town) Time: 3 days after the first vandalism incident Weapons: Spray paint, metal bat Suspects: Kohei Miki On the third day, however, it is revealed that Kogoro simply caught the vandaliser red-handed when the person was about to perform another vandalism. Mitsuhiko gives the culprit summary to Conan when Ayumi is wondering if they could keep the movie or not, but with Kogoro’s exclamation that he couldn’t do it without others’ help, both would make Conan look at Ayumi’s illustrated diary again and help him know something. Location: Beika Town There are still some anomalies prove that the vandalism was just a front for a bigger case. So the investigation continued and found some interesting details. Later, the boys ask Takagi and Chiba to see the Interrogation Tape and notice some other anomalies that prove Miki was used: Kohei Miki’s appearance has changed drastically in just 6 months. The vandalism may have been a cover for disabling the cameras, which would have prevented an impending crime at the Kaneko Jewelry Store where Kaneko had recently abandoned its high-end security system because it did not reduce the risk of robbery (and it was not their fault anyway). So they go to check Miki’s apartment and find more evidence for the earlier statements and at night, they are seen waiting in the Kaneko Jewelry Store for something, or someone.
